text.p: A HK$5.25 billion revolving credit facility for Henderson companies has been completed, Henderson announced on Tuesday.

Joint borrowers for the facility are Henderson Land Credit (1997) Ltd and Henderson Investment Credit (1997) Ltd. They are guaranteed by Henderson Land Development Co Ltd and Henderson Investment Ltd, respectively.
Bankers said the facility matures in five years and pays a margin of 48.5 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Twenty international banks joined the deal.

Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Bayerische Landesbank's Hongkong branch, Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch, Chase Manhattan Asia, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's Hongkong branch, Dresdner (South East Asia), Fuji Bank, JP Morgan Securities, NatWest Markets, Sanwa Bank, Sakura Bank, Societe Generale Asia, Sumitomo Bank, Westdeutsche Landesbank and Union Bank of Switzerland are arrangers.
Credit Lyonnais's Hongkong branch and Tokai Bank's Hongkong branch are co-arrangers.
Industrial Bank of Japan's Hongkong branch is a lead manager. Development Bank of Singapore and Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co's Hongkong branch are managers.
